description: Compare two to six keyboard sizes or real keyboards side by side: width, depth, key count, the keys each one is missing compared to the first, and how much desk / mouse room you gain. Accepts sizes ("TKL", "75%", "60") and keyboards reviewed on HLPlanet ("Wooting 60HE v2", "MCHOSE Jet 75"). Known keyboards: Redragon K761 Pro, Epomaker Galaxy100, NuPhy Air100 V3, ATK x QK Hex80, Wooting 80HE, GamaKay TK75 TMR, Yunzii RT75, NuPhy Kick75, Epomaker HE75 Mag, IQUNIX EZ75, Varmilo Minilo 75, Epomaker HE75 V2 TMR, DrunkDeer G75, MCHOSE Jet 75, XVX L75 Air, NuPhy Air75 V3, Keychron K3 HE, NuPhy Air75 HE, Keydous AJ68-CP, Epomaker HE65 V2 TMR, MCHOSE Ace 68 GT, Melgeek Made68 Ultra V2, Weikav NUT65, Varmilo Muse65 HE, Wooting 60HE v2, XVX Trooper63 HE, Epomaker Hack 59, Wooting 60HE+, IQUNIX EV63, DrunkDeer G60.

iso.description: Use the ISO layout (UK/EU, tall Enter, extra key by left Shift). Default ANSI.

keyboards.description: Sizes or keyboard names. The first one is the reference, e.g. ["TKL", "75%", "Wooting 80HE"]
